research_scope: Source-free independent contextual mathematics audit of ordinary-functor prerequisites. No new meanings, no source edits, no consolidation gate or human certification.

aliases.reason: The limit/colimit and finite-diagram sources define a diagram F:I→C as an ordinary identity/composition-preserving functor from an indexing category I to an arbitrary target category C, not a small-to-small functor. Thus a diagram's underlying functor is precisely the unrestricted ordinary-functor prerequisite; index finiteness, connectedness, cone structure and universal limit/colimit claims remain parent-specific.

The iso-comma-category source requires two ordinary covariant functors F:A→C and G:B→C, each preserving identities and composition without any smallness restriction. This invokes the general unrestricted ordinary-functor prerequisite twice; their shared codomain, the objects (a,b,α) and the iso-comma compatibility equations remain conditions only of the parent iso-comma construction.

The left-adjoint source uses ordinary functors L:C→D and R:D→C, differing only in domain/codomain orientation and naming from a generic identity/composition-preserving functor. Adjointness, naturality of Hom-bijections, and the fact that L and R have opposite domain assignments are extra parent constraints, not properties of an arbitrary functor.

The two-category-of-fibred-sets source uses functors H:E→E′ of total categories, ordinary functors at the level of objects/arrows, with the additional equation p′H=p. The general unrestricted functor prerequisite is identical while the over-base compatibility and fibration hypotheses remain source-specific and do not follow from ordinary functoriality.

A tensor bifunctor ⊗:C×C→C in a monoidal category is an ordinary covariant functor with source the product category C×C, preserving identities and compositions for pairs of arrows. Its bifunctor notation does not introduce a different functoriality axiom. Product-category construction, tensor object, associator and monoidal coherence remain source-specific and are not collapsed into arbitrary functor meaning.
